name: implement-slide-tools
description: Add an element picker, a multi-picker and PDF export (1 slide = 1 page) to an HTML slide deck. The picker copies a reference with a slide number, a readable DOM path, a text snippet and an :nth-of-type CSS path, so an agent can locate the exact element instead of guessing from "the blue box, bottom right". One self-contained HTML file, no dependencies.
